Compute the Evil Twins / Extreme EWMA cap for given intervals and weights. Vectorized: interval_months and uw can be vectors.

Source: R/adult_support.R
compute_et_limit.Rd

For built-in formulas (piecewise, piecewise-lower, allofus15), ET caps are derived from the formula's wtallow caps + 20 (for PW-H/PW-L) or equal to the allofus15 12m cap. For custom CSV formulas, fixed caps of 70/100 are used.

Usage

compute_et_limit(interval_months, formula = "piecewise", uw = NULL)

Arguments

interval_months

Interval in months (minimum neighbor gap)

formula

Character: "piecewise", "piecewise-lower", "allofus15", or path to custom CSV

uw

Optional numeric vector of upper weights (higher of two adjacent weights, or max(wt, ewma)). NULL = use base (UW=120) caps.

Value

Numeric vector of ET limits

References

Guide A, Sulieman L, Garbett S, Cronin RM, Spotnitz M, Natarajan K, Carroll RJ, Harris P, Chen Q. Identifying erroneous height and weight values from adult electronic health records in the All of Us research program. J Biomed Inform. 2024 Jul;155:104660. doi:10.1016/j.jbi.2024.104660 . (Source of the adapted "allofus15" formula.)
